search.select: SELECT b.id AS key, CASE WHEN b.title = '' THEN '(' || b.kind || ')' ELSE b.title END AS title, e.title || ' · ' || b.kind || coalesce(' · p. ' || b.page_start, '') AS meta, b.payload_sha256 AS payload, b.id AS part FROM blocks b JOIN entries e ON e.id = b.entry
